# The moment list (docs/architecture/scripted-moments.md, "The moment list"),
# read by the host's game at start: scripted moments found broken in game,
# marked so the guests sharing them watch through the host's eyes (watch),
# or keep their own eyes in a cutscene that plays well (play). The generic
# rule needs no entry here; an entry is a moment it got wrong.
#
#   watch KEY   # why, and the date it was seen
#   play KEY    # why
#
# KEY: scene:PATH or phase:PATH (a .scene or .questphase resource path, or
# its hash as the log writes it, 0x...), quest:TEXT (a piece of the host's
# tracked journal path, lower case). The scene decides before the phase,
# the phase before the quest. `tools/game.sh cmd story moments` on the host
# logs its scene, its running phases and its tracked path now; tandem.ini's
# moment_watch / moment_play add entries without touching this file.
#
# Examples (not entries):
#   watch scene:base\quest\...\NAME.scene  # the guest stood in a wall, 2026-12-01
#   watch quest:q101_  # every objective of a quest whose ids start q101_
#   play phase:0x0123456789abcdef  # short cutscenes the replay plays well
#
# No entries yet: nothing has been run in game (2026-11-21).
